In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb`, the test `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` now asserts `false` without setting `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` or stubbing `has_topic_embed?`, so it passes due to defaults/unstubbed behavior rather than verifying anything about hosts.
